task.description:
Design integration tests for OIDC-35 (Company onboarding orchestration). Write test spec at tests/specs/OIDC-35.md and implement integration tests per the test developer guide.

The feature branch feature/WF02-oidc35-20260528 contains the implementation. Tests must:
1. Cover the onboarding saga end-to-end using the real Keycloak adapter (no stubs per T-2)
2. Cover idempotency semantics (fresh 201, replay 200, conflict 409)
3. Cover GET /api/v1/onboarding/:id and GET /api/v1/onboarding?hostname=
4. Cover validation error cases (422)
5. Cover auth enforcement (401 without token, 403 without PLATFORM_ADMIN)
6. Use per-test UUIDs for all fixtures
7. Clean up after themselves (delete tenant, hostnames, onboarding records)
8. Fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL or Keycloak is unavailable

No error.SkipZigTest on any MUST test.

REWORK ITERATION 1 (TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR FAILED):
Issues:
- [BLOCKER] Missing integration test implementations for: TC-06 (saga creates tenant + hostname), TC-07 (saga compensation), TC-08 (input validation), TC-09 (slug validation). These cover AC #1, #3, #6 — MUST acceptance criteria.
- [MAJOR] TC-04, TC-05, TC-10, TC-11 use hardcoded static UUIDs instead of per-test generated UUIDs. Replace all static test UUIDs with per-test generated ones.

Fix both issues and update tests/integration/oidc35_onboarding_test.zig.
acceptance_criteria: All MUST acceptance criteria of OIDC-35 have runnable integration tests
No mocks, stubs, or in-memory fakes

result.summary: Fixed integration tests for OIDC-35: replaced static UUIDs with per-test generated UUIDs (TC-04, TC-05, TC-10, TC-11); implemented missing TCs TC-06 (saga creates tenant+hostname), TC-07 (saga compensation), TC-08 (input validation), TC-09 (slug validation)
